top_strength: Rep correctly identified the large move (1,900 sq ft) and properly routed to a specialist/walkthrough instead of attempting to quote on the call.
coaching_note: Before routing: deliver the quid pro quo framing ('takes 10–15 minutes, you'll get a quote you can depend on'), ask their agenda / key concerns about the move, and confirm moving day and destination city — all three would surface key details even for a walkthrough-routed call and prevent the customer feeling rushed off the phone.
booking_note: Agent transfers customer to a specialist for an in-home estimate: 'let me get you on over to that specialist so we can get you all settled away.'
